---
title: MRC2025 9.1
---

## ABOUT ME

This list contains a list of manga eligible for the following challenge item, as of October 26, 2025:

(9.1) Read a manga that is on one of the active MRC staff's Plan to Read list.

The list of eligible manga can be found under the [Manga List](#manga_list) section of the file. This list is sorted in alphabetical order and contains a hyperlink to their respective MAL page.

The list of MRC Staff members can be found in the [MRC Staff](#mrc_staff) section of this file. This list contains a link to their respective profile on MAL.

It is commonly recommended to take a screenshot of the manga listed on the MRC Staff member's Plan to Read section of their list so that in the event that the MRC Staff member removes it from their list sometime between when you completed it and when it gets inspected by the MRC Staff, it will not invalidate your challenge. Also, it is commonly recommended to have your MAL username appear somewhere in this screenshot.
